item.title: Show HN: I made a fun secure way to DM devs on GitHub
item.summary: Do you ever want to DM a developer on github? Or are a dev yourself and don't want to share your email? Introducing https://txta.dev - as long as you have an existing Github account and a public key you can send/receive messages securely which only the recipient can read! It's like facebook poking for devs! Send me a message with this command :) npx txtadev smashah "hello world" Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49277590 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
